name: Invidious
description: Invidious is an open source alternative front-end to YouTube. It lets you watch, search and subscribe to channels without ads, without tracking and without a Google account. Playback is handled by Invidious Companion, which fetches the video streams from YouTube on the server side.
author: iv-org

form_fields.label: Domain
form_fields.hint: Domain or IP used to reach the instance (leave empty when accessing it locally)

form_fields.label: External Port
form_fields.hint: Port used in generated links when behind a reverse proxy (default: the app port)

form_fields.label: HTTPS Only
form_fields.hint: Enable when the instance is served over HTTPS
